verdict.rationale: Bevy's first-party docs say it is open source under the permissive MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses. crates.io independently reports the license as 'MIT OR Apache-2.0', and the public GitHub repo (bevyengine/bevy) plus community comments corroborate the open-source availability. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation pointing users to the source repository for reading and browsing the engine code (the evidence only shows example source being viewable).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: It is free and open-source forever under your choice of the MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses.
